entities.name: Methyl ester saponification
observations: The supplied reaction is consistent with selective conversion of a methyl ester, COC(=O)–, to a carboxylic acid, C(=O)O; the oxime/isoxazoline-like heterocycle, aryl groups, and alkene framework remain unchanged.
Most likely conditions are LiOH in THF/methanol/water, followed by acidification; the matched record reports 1 hour and 93% yield.
Confidence is approximately 0.95 based on the direct reaction-database match and atom mapping.

entities.name: LiOH THF MeOH water
observations: Lithium hydroxide in a THF/methanol/water mixture is the most likely hydrolysis condition for the methyl ester; acidification is used in workup to isolate the neutral carboxylic acid.
Reported reaction time is approximately 1 hour and isolated yield is 93%.
